candidates.explanation: The verification mail for an email change builds its link with the path '/confirm-email'. That is the same path userSignUp uses. The frontend therefore opens the sign-up activation page, which posts the hash to /auth/email/confirm (AuthService.confirmEmail). That endpoint expects a user whose status is inactive and ignores newEmail, so the change is never applied. The link should point to the dedicated new-email page, '/confirm-new-email'. That page calls /auth/email/confirm/new (AuthService.confirmNewEmail), which applies the new email.

fix.description: In MailService.confirmNewEmail, change the URL path from '/confirm-email' to '/confirm-new-email'.
